---
title: "Trend radar"
subtitle: "Rising Google searches in the US, scored for Inflow Illustrated"
toc: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/dashboard_helpers.R")

rising <- read_data("rising_queries")
scores <- read_data("scores")
run_log <- read_data("run_log")

has_data <- !is.null(rising)

if (has_data) {
  runs_with_data <- sort(unique(rising$run_id), decreasing = TRUE)
  latest_data_run <- runs_with_data[1]
}
latest_run <- if (!is.null(run_log)) max(run_log$run_id) else NA
latest_log <- if (!is.null(run_log)) filter(run_log, run_id == latest_run) else NULL
answered <- if (!is.null(latest_log)) sum(latest_log$status %in% c("ok", "empty")) else 0
total <- if (!is.null(latest_log)) nrow(latest_log) else 0
latest_chile <- if (!is.null(latest_log)) latest_log$run_time_chile[1] else "never"
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (is.null(run_log)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo runs yet. Start one from the repository's **Actions** tab → *Trend radar* → *Run workflow*.\n:::\n")
} else {
  status_class <- if (answered == total) "callout-tip" else if (answered == 0) "callout-warning" else "callout-note"
  cat(sprintf(
    "::: {.%s}\n**Last run:** %s (Chile time) · Google answered **%d of %d** searches%s\n:::\n",
    status_class, latest_chile, answered, total,
    if (answered == 0) " — it was rate-limited, so the tables below show the most recent run that worked." else ""
  ))
}
```

## Best ideas right now

Queries from the latest run that worked, with a channel-fit score of 40 or more. Fit is scored once per query; growth is Google's "rising" percentage compared with the previous period of the same length.

```{r}
if (has_data) {
  latest <- filter(rising, run_id == latest_data_run)
  best <- summarise_queries(latest, scores) |>
    filter(!is.na(fit_score), fit_score >= 40) |>
    arrange(desc(fit_score), desc(best_growth))

  if (nrow(best) == 0) {
    note("Nothing in the latest run scored 40 or more for the channel.")
  } else {
    best |>
      transmute(
        Fit = fit_badge(fit_score),
        Query = link_html(query, link),
        Growth = growth_label(best_growth, breakout),
        Windows = windows,
        `Video angle` = htmlEscape(coalesce(video_angle, "")),
        Category = coalesce(category, ""),
        Seed = seeds
      ) |>
      dt_table(page_length = 10)
  }
} else {
  note("No data yet.")
}
```

## Ideas that keep coming back (last 7 days)

Queries seen in two or more runs. A query that stays on the rising list for days is usually a bigger story than a one-hour spike.

```{r}
if (has_data) {
  week_cut <- format(Sys.time() - 7 * 86400, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")
  week <- filter(rising, run_id >= week_cut)

  recurring <- week |>
    group_by(query) |>
    summarise(
      runs = n_distinct(run_id),
      first_seen = min(run_time_chile),
      last_seen = max(run_time_chile),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(runs >= 2) |>
    left_join(summarise_queries(week, scores), by = "query") |>
    arrange(desc(runs), desc(fit_score))

  if (nrow(recurring) == 0) {
    note("Nothing has appeared in more than one run yet.")
  } else {
    recurring |>
      transmute(
        Runs = runs,
        Fit = fit_badge(fit_score),
        Query = link_html(query, link),
        `Best growth` = growth_label(best_growth, breakout),
        `First seen` = first_seen,
        `Last seen` = last_seen,
        `Video angle` = htmlEscape(coalesce(video_angle, ""))
      ) |>
      dt_table(page_length = 10)
  }
}
```

## Everything rising in the latest run

All rising queries, including the ones that are not a fit, so you can spot what the scoring missed. Use the search box to filter by window or seed.

```{r}
if (has_data) {
  latest |>
    left_join(select(scores %||% tibble(query = character(), fit_score = character()),
                     query, fit_score), by = "query") |>
    mutate(growth = num(growth_pct), fit_score = num(fit_score)) |>
    arrange(match(window, WINDOW_ORDER), seed, as.integer(rank)) |>
    transmute(
      Window = window,
      Seed = seed,
      `#` = as.integer(rank),
      Query = link_html(query, trends_link),
      Growth = growth_label(growth, as.logical(is_breakout)),
      Fit = fit_badge(fit_score)
    ) |>
    dt_table(page_length = 25)
}
```
